slug: 2024-12-04 World Bank approves $70M for Morocco's social protection delivery (RNP and Unified Social Registry)

facts.fact: The World Bank says the first project designed and implemented the Unified Social Registry (RSU), which serves as the single entry point for new social programmes; the registry and RNP enrolled about half the population.

The World Bank project description says it supports the implementation of the Unified Social Registry (RSU) as a unique gateway for all social safety net programmes, including in rural and remote areas.

note: Nothing stated on a social registry.

facts.fact: The author says the Registre social unifié processes social and economic data to calculate an index used in targeting beneficiaries of social programmes.
The author says the Registre social unifié index is used in targeting beneficiaries of social programmes (plural, unnamed).

The Head of Government's department says 5.3 million families were enrolled in the Registre Social Unifie as of mid-September 2025, and 1.8 million RSU families received a supplementary school-year aid.

The RSU information system registers households through automated checking against more than 30 administrative databases, and held 4.1 million households (40% of the population) at 31 December 2023, per the Ministry of Interior document.
The Ministry of Interior document says the RSU is used to improve targeting of social protection programmes (plural) and that the RNP is used by social protection programmes.
Le Matin reports that Morocco selects 2026-27 university grant beneficiaries by the household score in the Unified Social Registry (RSU), and requires whole-household enrolment in it.

systems.owner: Ministries of Interior and National Education

note: Registry named as a Jisr user; its service status and programmes are not stated.

facts.fact: ANSS says households must be enrolled in the Registre Social Unifié and have a socio-economic score at or under 9.743001, computed on rsu.ma, to receive direct social aid (ASD).
The ID4Africa slide dates the National System for Identifying and Targeting Beneficiaries of Social Programs (RNP-RSU) to December 2022 as a reform achievement.

The ID4Africa slide lists health insurance for vulnerable groups (11 million beneficiaries), direct cash transfer (3.9 million households), the Minhaty scholarship and health insurance for non-covered groups as achievements under RNP-RSU.
The minister described the Registre social unifié (RSU) as a project using the common interconnection platform, with about 170,000 operations a day to August 2023.

facts.fact: The ANSS annual report, as reported by Le Brief, says the RSU is crossed with the population register to target direct social aid, with 84% of aid going to the poorest three deciles.

The government's written answer says registration in the Unified Social Register (RSU) generates a household score from 35 urban or 28 rural variables under Law 72.18, and households' data are updated at least yearly.
The government's written answer says the RSU-based system is the reference framework for access to social support programmes, including direct cash transfers and mandatory basic health insurance.
The Interior Ministry's annual report refers to the Registre social unifié as holding data it updates, with citizens' enrolment in the beneficiary targeting system continuing in 2026.

note: RSU is named only as an integrated programme; the deck does not describe it as a registry.
